text:
Four power banks in these results support Qi2.2 25W wireless charging, plus one that is Japan-only.

| Power bank | Details | Price / availability |
|---|---|---|
| **Baseus PicoGo AM52** (10,000 mAh) | 25W Qi2.2 (WPC certified), 45W USB-C out, 30W recharge | $79.99 on Amazon US. $59.99 on Baseus's site, or $53.99 with code AM52 (a deal site reports testing it on 2026-10-24). |
| **Anker MagGo 2 Pro** (10,000 mAh) | 25W Qi2.2, active cooling fan, 45W USB-C in and out, built-in stand and display | $109.99. Pre-order, shipping Oct 21 to Nov 9, 2026. |
| **UGREEN MagFlow 25W** | The first Qi2.2-certified power bank, per UGREEN | Planned for the UGREEN site and Amazon. I didn't find a current product page or price. |
| **ESR MagSlim** (10,000 mAh) | 25W Qi2, 13.8 mm thick, optimized for the iPhone 17 series | Sold on Amazon and ESR's site. I didn't find a product page or price. |

- **Baseus PicoGo AM52:** [Buy at Baseus](https://dealectric.com/go/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w). This is an affiliate link, so the site earns a commission at no cost to you. Details are on the [product page](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w) and in [Notebookcheck's coverage](https://www.notebookcheck.net/Baseus-launches-new-Qi2-2-25W-certified-10-000-mAh-power-bank-with-slim-design.1223437.0.html).
- **Anker MagGo 2 Pro:** [Anker US page](https://www.anker.com/products/a110r-qi2-maggo-2-pro-magnetic-power-bank?Sort_by=Recommended&collections_anker-earth-day-sale-2026=&variant=46550444277910).
- **UGREEN MagFlow 25W:** [UGREEN's announcement](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/ugreen-pioneers-next-gen-wireless-charging-with-magflow-25w-the-worlds-first-qi-2-2-certified-power-bank-302505385.html). Search "UGREEN MagFlow Qi2.2" on Amazon or UGREEN's store for current listings.
- **ESR MagSlim:** [ESR's CES 2026 release](https://www.prnewswire.com/news-releases/esr-expands-its-qi2-25w-wireless-charging-lineup-advancing-everyday-charging-at-ces-2026-302653572.html). ESR calls it "Qi2 25W," so confirm the Qi2.2 certification before buying.
- **CIO SMARTCOBY Ex05 Wireless2.2 Pro CABLE SS10K:** It supports Qi2.2 25W but was released in Japan (¥8,980), so it's probably not practical for a US shopper. See the [release](https://prtimes.jp/main/html/rd/p/000000665.000043212.html).

**Phone compatibility:** The full 25W only works with phones that support Qi2.2.
- Baseus lists 25W for the iPhone 16 and 17 series (not the 16e, and on iOS 26). Older iPhones (12 to 15) get 15W.
- Notebookcheck says the AM52 also works at 25W with the Pixel 10 Pro XL.
- Anker lists compatibility with the iPhone 13 to 17 (except the 16e), but I'd expect older models to charge more slowly.

**Which to pick:**
- **Best value:** The Baseus AM52 is the cheapest at roughly $54 to $60 with the code, and it's in stock.
- **Best cooling:** The Anker MagGo 2 Pro costs more but adds active cooling, which helps hold 25W during long charges. It's pre-order only.
- **Thinnest:** The ESR MagSlim is the slimmest at 13.8 mm, but I don't have a price or confirmed certification.
